item.title: Once Human Reveals More Details About This Week's Console Closed Beta and 'Deviant Update'
item.description: Once Human's console closed beta begins on Thursday, and NetEase Games has just announced more details about this first beta and the live game update out that day that will add tricky new Deviants.

item.title: Pearl Abyss 'Unintentionally' Left AI Art Assets in Crimson Desert and Vows to Replace Them
item.description: Pearl Abyss says they "unintentionally" left art assets made with AI in Crimson Desert, and will replace them, promising greater transparency in the future.

item.title: Hero Wars Is Dropping Its Most Exciting New Hero Yet, and She Brought a Bear [Sponsored]
item.description: Hero Wars: Dominion Era is introducing Byrna, a young orc shaman blessed by the Bear Spirit Ursa who brings powerful sustained healing and damage mitigation to any team. [Sponsored]

item.title: Neverwinter Adds Shoulder Cats and Brings Back April Fowls, With a New Mount and Chicken Outfit
item.description: Neverwinter is, once again, getting things rolling on its April Fowls event. The team has also added a new type of vanity pet, Shoulder Buddies, first in the form of kitties.

item.title: Midnight's Magic and Mayhem: WoW's Latest Expansion Is a Wild Ride
item.description: Robin is here with a mid-review update for World of Warcraft: Midnight in her latest column

item.title: The Elder Scrolls Online Team Will Outline Update 50's Player Experience Improvements This Week
item.description: The Elder Scrolls Online team is set to unveil player experience changes and improvements ahead in Update 50.

item.title: Soulframe Removing Fey Pact XP in Preludes 14, Which Gets a Preview Devstream This Week
item.description: Digital Extremes will remove XP earned in Soulframe from the discontinued Fey Pact in Preludes 14, which gets a preview later this week.

item.title: Brew Day is Back in EverQuest, With New Quests and Returning Content
item.description: Brew Day is back in EverQuest, and this year's event features new quest content and a new collection, as well as festive returning stuff to do.

item.title: GDC 2026: EverQuest Legends Aims To Recreate Classic EverQuest, But More Approachable For New Players
item.description: EverQuest was released back in 1999, and its hardcore MMO experience is still around today. EverQuest Legends is a new spin-off by Daybreak that aims to recreate that original experience, but in a more approachable, soloable way.

item.title: Albion Online is Launching on Xbox in April, With Expanded Controller Support and Full Cross-Progression
item.description: Albion Online's upcoming Xbox launch now has a release date. The fantasy sandbox MMORPG will land on console in April.
